block.name: write
block.arguments:
{"file_path": "contract.yml", "content": "id: authored-workshop
version: '1'
title: Installed numeric analysis
inputs:
  - { name: flowRoot, description: Read-only source numbers }
  - { name: design, description: Input set }
  - { name: workspaceRoot, description: Campaign workspaces }
outputs:
  - { name: numbers, path: flow/numbers.txt, description: Source measurements }
  - { name: analysis, path: research/analysis/result.txt, reader: sum-file, description: Scaled sum }
environment:
  wrappers: [sh]
workspace:
  copy: [numbers.txt]
workshops:
  - id: analyze
    purpose: Read the actual numbers, write a script to sum them, scale by SCALE and produce analysis.
    directory: research/analysis
    entry: entry.sh
    language: sh
    inputs: [SCALE]
    reads: [numbers]
    knowledge: [sum.md]
    produces: analysis
    argv: [sh, '${ENTRY}', '${WORKSHOP}', '${WORKSPACE}', '${SCALE}']
rules: [sum-valid]
knowledge:
  - { file: sum.md, purpose: How to calculate the scaled sum }
strategy:
  scale: { type: number, unit: count, min: 1, max: 4, default: 2 }
words:
  scale: { label: scale factor, unit: count }
"}

block.name: write
write
block.arguments:
{"file_path": "semantics.yml", "content": "values:
  scaled_sum:
    unit: count
    description: Sum of source integers multiplied by scale
"}

block.name: write
write
block.arguments: {"file_path": "knowledge/sum.md", "content": "# Scaled sum\nRead each source integer, sum all of them and multiply by SCALE. Never substitute a canned answer.\n"}

block.text: The declared files are written. Ask the Host to check their actual validity.
